schema_version.description: 2 adds the optional wheelhouse screens and controls lists

subject.description: t-class, k-class, or a landing stop id

screens.description: Wheelhouse only, schema_version 2: one entry per console screen mount

controls.description: Wheelhouse only, schema_version 2: one entry per lever, button, switch, lamp, needle or card

direction.description: Unit vector in the layout frame: x starboard, y up, z forward

id.description: Mount name in the prefab, for example PlotterScreen

centre.description: [x from centreline, y above floor, z from the forward window, negative aft], m

size.description: [width, height] of the lit area, m

tilt.description: deg from vertical; positive leans the top of the screen away from the operator

focus_eye.description: Camera position for the lean-in view, same convention as centre, m

id.description: Mount name in the prefab, for example PortLever

pivot.description: [x from centreline, y above floor, z from the forward window, negative aft], m

axis.description: Rotation axis through the pivot; positive travel is a positive rotation about it

travel.description: [minimum, maximum] deg about axis; the rest pose is 0

normal.description: Out of the panel face toward the operator; keybind popups fade by it

lamp.description: Index of this lamp in the shared lamp bank, counting from 0

label.description: Generic function text, for example Port engine lever; no maker or boat names
